slides.title: THE PRODUCT RULE, STEP BY STEP
THE RULE
lines: d/dx [f(x) · g(x)] = f′(x) · g(x) + f(x) · g′(x)
slides.note: Derivative of the first times the second, plus the first times the derivative of the second.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
steps: g = sin x, g′ = cos x

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: The derivative of a product is not the product of the derivatives.
You need both terms: f′g and fg′.

pageTitle: The Product Rule: How to Differentiate a Product of Functions
